item.title: The TV Foundation Announces 17 Founding Class Confident Organisations
item.description: The TV Foundation Announces 17 Founding Class Confident Organisations Broadcasters and production companies join the movement to improve working class representation in the TV industry. Published today, The TV Foundation announces the 17 founding Class Confident organisations. They have all applied to join the Class Confident movement to remove barriers for people from working class backgrounds to get into and stay in the TV industry.
